name: Seigikan Afureru Shounen ga Succubus ni Shinu made Shasei Kanri Sare Tsuzukeru Hanashi
original_name: 正義感溢れる少年がサキュバスに死ぬまで射精管理され続ける話
source:
The hero may have defeated countless succubi in his time, but this one is different...
Her body, her aura -- something is very wrong. But before he can act or his misgivings,
our hero is pulled into a nigh-inescapable orgasm trap from which he may never return!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE259634.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这位英雄在他的时代可能已经击败了无数的魅魔，但这一位不同……
她的身体，她的气场——有些地方很不对劲。但在他采取行动或表达疑虑之前，
我们的英雄被拉入了一个几乎无法逃脱的高潮陷阱，他可能永远不会回来！
